name: env-guard
description: Protects .env files, SSH keys and credential stores from being read or modified.

extraProtected.title: Extra protected paths
extraProtected.description: Comma-separated globs to protect in addition to the built-in list, e.g. secrets/*,*.tfvars.

allowed.title: Allowed paths
allowed.description: Comma-separated globs that are never blocked, e.g. .env.test,fixtures/*.pem.
